pages.text: Family Trees are not actual trees. They bear no leaves nor create saplings. The $(l:blocks/bondknot)$(c)$(o)Bondknot$() trunk is nonetheless wood-like and can be used as such. The trees themselves are decorated with $(l:blocks/heart_transplant)$(c)$(o)Heart Transplants$(), Ribcages and $(l:materials/crystallized_bonds)$(c)$(o)Crystallized Bonds$(). The Family Trees primarily form by a strong desire of a family to stay together, especially when grieving.

pages.title: Family Tree
pages.text: A showcase of the power that familial bonds can have.
